group: atRoot() - normal behavior with different PathType implementations

cases.description: When the validator is constructed with a PathType whose getRoot() returns the JSONPath root symbol "$", atRoot() should return "$".
When the validator is constructed with a PathType whose getRoot() returns an empty string (typical for JSON Pointer), atRoot() should return an empty string.
When the validator is constructed with a PathType whose getRoot() returns "/" (another possible root for JSON Pointer), atRoot() should return "/".
When the validator is constructed with a PathType whose getRoot() returns null, atRoot() should propagate the null value without throwing an exception.
When the validator is constructed with a null PathType, atRoot() should throw NullPointerException because it attempts to call getRoot() on a null reference.
When the PathType implementation's getRoot() method throws IllegalStateException, atRoot() should propagate the exception without handling it.
